explication: ASP.NET Core is a modular, cross-platform framework for building web and connected applications. A representative request workflow enters through a web server, is represented as an HTTP context, and can be routed through endpoint filters to a result; the supplied excerpts directly show the filter builder invoking a request delegate and executing its return value. The tree also shows substantial MVC, identity, security, real-time, caching, and component capabilities. Many of their runtime connections are not evidenced in the excerpts, so those links are omitted rather than inferred.
